flash_loan_obtained.meaning: attacker has flash-loaned tokens used to manipulate the Uniswap V2 pool

spot_price_manipulated.meaning: Uniswap V2 pool spot price is manipulated before buyBack() is called

slippage_check_passed.meaning: validatePrice(maxSlippage) returns true (slippage check passes) with TWAP equal to the manipulated spot price and post-swap check comparing against the already-manipulated previousPrice

claims.scope: UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice() TWAP check used by BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS() and liquidity managers

preconditions.text: Attacker has flash-loaned tokens to manipulate the Uniswap V2 pool price.; The Uniswap V2 pool spot price is manipulated before buyBack() is called.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: validatePrice() should compute a TWAP distinct from the current spot price so that slippage protection in BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS() rejects swaps when the price deviates beyond maxSlippage.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: validatePrice(maxSlippage) passes with TWAP equal to the manipulated spot price, and the post-swap check compares against the already-manipulated previousPrice so it also passes.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: buyBack() is callable by the attacker (permissionless or otherwise accessible); the report does not establish access control on buyBack().
The flash-loan and pool-manipulation steps are an attack narrative, not observed transactions.
validatePrice() is invoked within BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS() before the swap executes.

limitations: The condition encodes the concrete attack scenario (flash loan plus manipulated spot price) rather than a general 'any caller' scope, because the report only establishes this subcase.
The relation forbids the slippage check passing under manipulation; it does not formalize the downstream unfavorable swap or fund loss, which are separate impacts.
Numeric TWAP/spot deviation versus maxSlippage is not defined in the report; the Boolean check-pass outcome stands in for the deviation comparison.
